description: This file defines an API route for creating SelectedCalendar records based on Credential records associated with Delegation Credentials. It includes functions for validation, email comparison, processing delegation user credentials, and orchestrating the creation process, primarily for Google Calendar integration.

methods.name: isSameEmail
methods.description: Compares two emails to determine if they are equivalent, considering plus addressing for Google emails.

methods.name: getDelegationUserCredentialsToProcess
methods.description: Filters and processes delegation user credentials, reusing existing SelectedCalendar records where possible.

methods.name: getCalendarService
methods.description: Retrieves a Google Calendar service instance for a given delegation user credential.

methods.name: fetchPrimaryCalendarId
methods.description: Fetches the primary calendar ID for a user, with error handling for invalid grants.

methods.name: processDelegationUserCredential
methods.description: Creates a SelectedCalendar record for a delegation user credential, handling email mismatches.

methods.name: handleCreateSelectedCalendars
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that processes all delegation credentials and creates corresponding SelectedCalendar records.
